I'm now focusing on system integration testing and regression across all developed stories. This phase also includes updating user documentation and release notes, with an estimated effort of 3.5 days.

technical_and_design_decisions: Admin UI Job Creation (U1): Investigate REST API security filter chain and role mapping vs Shell execution paths; surface nested server-side exceptions properly to logs and HTTP response payload.
Explicit Partitioning (U2): Extend Stream Deployment options and Binder SPI to accept explicit partition count overrides per producer module.
Dynamic Kafka Subscriptions (U3): Upgrade Kafka binder/source consumer handling to support pattern matching and dynamic partition rebalance listeners.

HDFS Sink Enhancements (U4 & U5): Introduce boolean properties `useSyncable` and `useInUseSuffix` (defaulting to true) in `HdfsTextWrittenOption` and `HdfsDataWriter` pipeline to manage flush/sync behavior and stream output paths.
Module Automation Plugins (U6): Create Maven mojo and Gradle task leveraging the Spring XD Admin REST API `/modules` endpoint for artifact deployment.
Custom Module Versioning (U7): Extend module registry coordinates to include version identifiers (`type/name/version`) and update stream parser resolution to support versioned artifacts.
PHD 3.0 Certification (U8): Upgrade Hadoop dependencies to match Pivotal HD 3.0 / ODP baseline and verify binary compatibility across HDFS, YARN, and MapReduce integration tests.
assumptions: Development work is carried out by a single experienced senior Java developer familiar with the Spring Framework, Spring XD architecture, Kafka, and Hadoop ecosystems.
A local/virtual PHD 3.0 and Kafka test environment is available or easy to stand up for integration verification.
Existing REST APIs for module upload require minimal backend modification to support Maven/Gradle artifact pushing.
Effort estimates include developer testing (unit and integration tests), code documentation, and bug fixing during development.

activities.activity_name: Fix Admin UI Job Creation Role Issue and Logging (U1)
activities.activity_description: Investigate REST/UI authorization discrepancy for ROLE_CREATE and ROLE_ADMIN during job creation, fix UI security controller mapping, and add detailed exception logging in the admin server.
Add support for explicit partition count properties in module deployment manifests, message bus binders, and routing logic.

activities.activity_name: Add Dynamic Partition Subscription to Kafka Source Module (U3)
activities.activity_description: Enhance Kafka source module to support dynamic partition assignment and subscription patterns without needing fixed partition mappings.

activities.activity_name: Implement Syncable Writes Option for HDFS Sink (U4)
activities.activity_description: Extend HDFS sink module options to allow enabling Syncable HDFS API writes for immediate flush and improved resiliency on sink failure.

activities.activity_name: Add Option to Disable inUseSuffix in HDFS Sink (U5)
activities.activity_description: Modify HDFS file writer logic to support direct writing to final output filenames without applying temporary file extensions like .tmp.

activities.activity_name: Develop Maven and Gradle Plugin Targets for Custom Module Upload (U6)
activities.activity_description: Implement build tool plugin goals/tasks to automate packaging and uploading custom module fragments directly to the Spring XD registry via REST endpoints.
Extend module registry, stream deployment engine, and module resolution mechanisms to support module semantic versioning and incremental rollouts.
Update Hadoop dependency matrices to Pivotal HD 3.0 / ODP standards, execute integration test suites against PHD 3.0, and resolve compatibility issues.
Perform full system integration testing across all updated modules, verify build artifacts, and update user/developer documentation.
